messages.text: Welcome! Everyone starts somewhere. I'll show you how to build your credit from zero.
Which of these fits you best?
How long have you been in the UK?
How long have you had a UK bank account?
Have you got a credit report yet? Even a short one helps. Upload it, use a sample, or tap Skip.
Thanks, Mei. I've got your Experian report. Your score there is 455 out of 999.
Your sample already has three months of bank data in it, so you can skip this, or hand me a different statement.
Got it. After rent, bills and the basics you have about £400 a month left over.
Here's how you start from zero. The first three steps:
9 Nov 2026: Know where you're starting.
9 Nov 2026: Avoid the thin-file traps.
9 Nov 2026: Check if you can register to vote.
Now, what would you like to aim for? Pick one, or tell me in your own words.
What score would you like to reach? Your Experian score is 455 today.
And how soon? I can plan for the next 3 months or the next 6.
Thanks! Give me a moment to build your plan towards a score of 500.
You don't have bad credit, you have very little of it. This plan builds it from zero.
Here's what's holding your score back, worst first.
You have no active credit accounts, so lenders have little to go on (a "thin file").
You have no credit cards, so lenders can't see how you handle revolving credit.
You're not on the electoral roll, and you may not be eligible to join it. Using one address everywhere helps lenders verify you instead.
One thing in your spending stands out: £30/month on buy now, pay later.
About your Vodafone letter. It didn't give a reason, so I've worked out the most likely ones from your report.
The one fix that matters most: build some history first. Follow the build-from-zero plan: electoral roll, Experian Boost, bills in your name, then a credit builder card.
Don't apply again before Jan 2027. Run the lender's eligibility checker first. It's a soft search, so it won't show to other lenders. Only apply if it says yes.
You have rights here too. The lender must name the agency it used, and you can see and correct your Experian report for free.
Here's all of that on one sheet. Tap it to read it, or take a copy with you.
Right, let's make you a plan. You said 3 months. Shall we stick with that, or go for 6?
Here's your 3-month plan: 9 steps, week by week. Tap any step to see why it's there.

9 Nov 2026: Check if you can register to vote.

9 Nov 2026: Stop new buy now, pay later.
16 Nov 2026: Put a household bill in your name.
1 Feb 2027: Try a monthly phone contract again.
9 Feb 2027: Get your rent reported.
If you stick to it, your Experian score could be 465 to 520 by Feb 2027. That's an estimate, not a promise.
When you're ready for a new card, start with the Capital One Classic, from Feb 2027. Check with QuickCheck first: it won't leave a mark.
